INSERT INTO _vault_changes SELECT 'accounts',tenant,name,NULL,NULL,balance,-1 FROM main.accounts WHERE tenant=(SELECT tenant FROM _vault_scope)

CREATE TEMP TRIGGER _vault_accounts_before_insert BEFORE INSERT ON main.accounts BEGIN INSERT INTO _vault_accounts_values SELECT NEW.tenant,NEW.name,NEW.balance,(SELECT count(*) FROM main.accounts AS stored WHERE stored.tenant IS NEW.tenant AND typeof(stored.tenant) = typeof(NEW.tenant) AND stored.name IS NEW.name AND typeof(stored.name) = typeof(NEW.name) AND stored.balance IS NEW.balance AND typeof(stored.balance) = typeof(NEW.balance)) WHERE NEW.tenant IS NOT (SELECT tenant FROM _vault_scope) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM _vault_accounts_values AS stored WHERE stored.tenant IS NEW.tenant AND typeof(stored.tenant) = typeof(NEW.tenant) AND stored.name IS NEW.name AND typeof(stored.name) = typeof(NEW.name) AND stored.balance IS NEW.balance AND typeof(stored.balance) = typeof(NEW.balance)); INSERT INTO _vault_accounts_values SELECT victim.tenant,victim.name,victim.balance,(SELECT count(*) FROM main.accounts AS stored WHERE stored.tenant IS victim.tenant AND typeof(stored.tenant) = typeof(victim.tenant) AND stored.name IS victim.name AND typeof(stored.name) = typeof(victim.name) AND stored.balance IS victim.balance AND typeof(stored.balance) = typeof(victim.balance)) FROM main.accounts AS victim WHERE (victim.rowid = NEW.rowid OR (victim.tenant = NEW.tenant AND victim.name = NEW.name)) AND victim.tenant IS NOT (SELECT tenant FROM _vault_scope) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM _vault_accounts_values AS stored WHERE stored.tenant IS victim.tenant AND typeof(stored.tenant) = typeof(victim.tenant) AND stored.name IS victim.name AND typeof(stored.name) = typeof(victim.name) AND stored.balance IS victim.balance AND typeof(stored.balance) = typeof(victim.balance)); END

INSERT INTO _vault_changes SELECT 'accounts',tenant,name,NULL,NULL,balance,1 FROM main.accounts WHERE tenant=(SELECT tenant FROM _vault_scope)

CREATE TEMP TRIGGER _vault_verify BEFORE UPDATE ON _vault_scope BEGIN 
        SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'invalid storage effect') WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM _vault_changes
        GROUP BY kind, tenant, typeof(tenant), identity, typeof(identity),
                 source, typeof(source), target, typeof(target), value, typeof(value)
        HAVING sum(delta) != 0
        );
     SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'invalid storage effect') WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM _vault_accounts_values AS attempted WHERE initial_count != (SELECT count(*) FROM main.accounts AS stored WHERE stored.tenant IS attempted.tenant AND typeof(stored.tenant) = typeof(attempted.tenant) AND stored.name IS attempted.name AND typeof(stored.name) = typeof(attempted.name) AND stored.balance IS attempted.balance AND typeof(stored.balance) = typeof(attempted.balance))); SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'invalid storage effect') WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM _vault_transfers_values AS attempted WHERE initial_count != (SELECT count(*) FROM main.transfers AS stored WHERE stored.tenant IS attempted.tenant AND typeof(stored.tenant) = typeof(attempted.tenant) AND stored.key IS attempted.key AND typeof(stored.key) = typeof(attempted.key) AND stored.source IS attempted.source AND typeof(stored.source) = typeof(attempted.source) AND stored.target IS attempted.target AND typeof(stored.target) = typeof(attempted.target) AND stored.amount IS attempted.amount AND typeof(stored.amount) = typeof(attempted.amount))); SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'invalid storage effect') WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM _vault_audit_values AS attempted WHERE initial_count != (SELECT count(*) FROM main.audit AS stored WHERE stored.tenant IS attempted.tenant AND typeof(stored.tenant) = typeof(attempted.tenant) AND stored.key IS attempted.key AND typeof(stored.key) = typeof(attempted.key) AND stored.source IS attempted.source AND typeof(stored.source) = typeof(attempted.source) AND stored.target IS attempted.target AND typeof(stored.target) = typeof(attempted.target) AND stored.amount IS attempted.amount AND typeof(stored.amount) = typeof(attempted.amount))); END
